mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN book_type = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalIncome, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN book_type = 2 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalExpense FROM personal_book WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND create_by = #{owner} AND DATE_FORMAT(book_date, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(book_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN book_type = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN book_type = 2 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expense FROM personal_book WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND create_by = #{owner} AND DATE_FORMAT(book_date, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth} GROUP BY book_date ORDER BY book_date ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(book_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN book_type = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN book_type = 2 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expense, COUNT(*) AS count FROM personal_book WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND create_by = #{owner} AND DATE_FORMAT(book_date, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth} GROUP BY book_date ORDER BY book_date ASC

SELECT pb.category_id AS categoryId, bc.name AS categoryName, COALESCE(SUM(pb.amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS count FROM personal_book pb LEFT JOIN book_category bc ON bc.id = pb.category_id AND bc.is_deleted = 0 WHERE pb.is_deleted = 0 AND pb.create_by = #{owner} AND pb.book_type = 2 AND DATE_FORMAT(pb.book_date, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth} GROUP BY pb.category_id, bc.name ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 8
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(current_balance), 0) AS totalAssets FROM book_account WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 0
